# ScrcpyNet attribution

This directory vendors the ScrcpyNet and ScrcpyNet.Wpf source from
https://github.com/Fusion86/ScrcpyNet at commit
80027a8203c0ddb87b1e2f56016a4630e1bd2e24.

The vendored source is retained under the upstream Apache License 2.0. The
source and runtime files are intentionally limited to the core and WPF
projects required by DeepDroidChanger; samples, benchmarks, and Avalonia
projects are not included. Local lifecycle and dynamic-port changes are
documented in the source comments.

ScrcpyNet uses the scrcpy server implementation and FFmpeg native libraries.
See the dependency package metadata and the upstream projects for their
respective notices.
